## Structure

- `cli/` contains command entry points.
- `deployment/` owns deployment targets, Cloudflare adapters, and GitHub workflow selection.
- `i18n/` validates translation structure and formatting.

Keep application differences in the deployment registry. Apps should not own deployment scripts.

<details>
<summary><strong>Architecture</strong></summary>

cli/
  deploy-cloudflare.mts
  deployment-context.mts
  lint.mts
deployment/
